# Amsterdam food notes

What we ate, and what to order next time.

## Notreal Food Tours, Jordaan walk (Sun 13)
Guide: Sanne, very funny, grew up on the Lindengracht. Eight stops, 3 hours.
- Old Amsterdam cheese aged 4 years: crunchy crystals, best thing on the tour
- Bitterballen with mustard at a brown cafe
- Raw herring "Hollandse nieuwe" with onions and pickles. Priya loved it, I didn't
- Appeltaart with whipped cream: tall, dense, cinnamon
- Stroopwafel made fresh, eaten warm over a coffee cup
- Jenever tasting: young vs old (oude) jenever
- Tip: EUR 20 cash to Sanne

## Restaurant Warung Example (Mon 14)
Indonesian rijsttafel, 16 small dishes. Rendang was the standout; sambal
goreng udang too hot for Priya. Next time: order the vegetarian version too.

## Albert Cuyp Market (Tue 15)
Kibbeling (fried cod) with garlic sauce, herring broodje, a stroopwafel the size
of a plate. All cash.

## Fake Kaasbar (Tue 15)
Five cheeses, five beers. Favourite pairing: smoked goat cheese with a Dutch tripel.
Bought 500 g of the aged Gouda to bring home (declared at customs).

## Restaurant Example 41 (Thu 17, anniversary)
Seven-course tasting menu with the wine pairing. Chef sent out a dessert with
"10" in chocolate. Table by the window. Best meal of the trip.
Priya cried a little at the toast. Kept the menu.

## Poffertjes at Zaanse Schans
Tiny pancakes, butter and powdered sugar. Ate two portions.

## To try next time
Indische rijsttafel at another place to compare; snert (pea soup) if we go in winter;
the Foodhallen-style hall in Oost.
